_components_comment: Per-part switches for RSI. Flipping one here is the whole toggle — no rebuild, no crontab PR. daily_review gates the nightly headless Opus pass over the transcript corpus (rsi-daily-review checks this before it spends anything; absent or unreadable config reads as OFF, because that run costs usage). permission_ledger gates the 17:30 permission-friction evaluator (run-evaluate.sh; absent config reads as ON, because capture is already running and only this stage turns it into something a human sees). auto_research gates the research pass over selected observations, which runs from /review-improvements rather than cron. self_compact gates the autonomous context lifecycle: the Stop hook self-compact-trigger.py writes a mission handoff once a session crosses self_compact.threshold of its detected context window, and scripts/idle-handoff.sh then resumes the work in a fresh process. Absent, malformed, or any non-boolean value reads as OFF, because the resume runs opus-5. It does NOT auto-invoke /compact or /clear — those are never agent-triggered.
_self_compact_comment: threshold is a fraction of the DETECTED window (0.30 = ~300k on a 1M model), deliberately aggressive relative to the 70% advisory nudge in context-baggage.py; both are live and independent. max_fires_per_session caps the once-per-crossing loop bound so a session oscillating around the threshold cannot re-fire indefinitely.
north_star: I co-create a flourishing world by caring deeply. Present in my body, I allow my care to manifest through my actions, directing me to work for the flourishing of all beings, including humans, animals, and myself. For animals: avoid exploitation (vegan). For humans/me: Be well, be in agentic loving care, get rid of old restrictive patterns, freedom of self-expression, capability and dynamic range. Also: boost myself and my relationships/communities, both for joy of doing it, but also for increased capacity to work for the good of all.
